column3: Drive scopes are path roots in the one files tree (/me, /projects/<slug>, /captains/<id>, /automations/<id>), not a new table; skills move from kv to /me/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and the skills row now requires drive
column4: one index, one blob store and one revision history serve every scope; a second store would duplicate files and skills; the skills row needs drive at apply time so the kv move finishes before skill.list answers (an optional ctx.inject callback ran after the first op)
column5: plugins/drive/drive.test.ts: versions survive write/checkout/move, AGENTS.md served from cache after its blob is deleted and reloaded after a write, a cached turn reads no more rows than a home without Drive files, legacy kv skill moved on evict, thread grant opens /captains/<own>/ only
